name: manual_906756
claim: Keep state shared between a packaged desktop agent host and ordinary terminals outside the user's AppData; verify from a process started outside the package.

decisions.notes: MSIX-packaged processes get AppData writes redirected into a private package store, so a CA created there was invisible to a normal launch and a second CA would have broken the peer's pin. 2026-10-25.

rationale: MSIX-packaged processes get AppData writes redirected into a private package store, so a CA created there was invisible to a normal launch and a second CA would have broken the peer's pin. 2026-10-25.
